work_completed: Task B: Fixed the continuity bug in sleepwalker_protocol/protocol.py. assess_interaction previously passed user_input (the message text) into ContinuityManager.get_context() as the user_id, so continuity always reported 'no history'.

Threaded a stable user_id: added a user_id parameter to SWP.__init__ (falls back to a TOI-declared user_id, then to 'default_user') and a user_id parameter to assess_interaction, which now keys continuity on user_id (defaulting to the instance's stable id) instead of the message text.

Added two behavioral tests in tests/test_protocol.py that assert a second assessment for the same user_id actually sees the first's persisted context (not just return shape). Verified both tests fail against the pre-fix protocol.py and pass after the fix.
Compliance: registered this session and wrote this handoff per AGENTS.md / OTOI Section 3 & 5; updated docs/active-threads.md.
decisions_made: Kept the read/write separation: assess_interaction reads continuity, maintain_continuity persists it. The fix corrects the read KEY only; it does not add an implicit disk write to assess_interaction (consistent with the repo's privacy posture).
Default instance user_id is 'default_user' so a single SWP instance keeps continuity across calls even when callers do not pass an explicit id.
